senses.gloss: anointing, official installation; שמן המ׳ the oil used for installation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 3:4">Hor. III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:9">Meg. I, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02846"><he>מָשַׁח</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 13:1">Tosef. Sot. XIII, 1</cite> <he>גנז … וצנצנת של שמן המ׳</he> (Josiah) removed out of sight the Ark … and the bottle of the oil of installation (made by Moses).
<cite ref="Horayot 11b:10">Hor. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ המ׳ … היו שולקין וכ׳</he> in the oil of installation which Moses prepared, they boiled the roots of spices.

Ib. נמעול מש׳ המ׳ Ms. M. (ed. omit המ׳) dare we desecrate the sacred oil (by using it for non-Davidic kings)? Ib. 12ᵃ ומי הוה ש׳ המ׳ did any oil for the installation exist (in the days of Joahaz)?; a. v. fr.—הר המ׳ (= b. h. הר הזיתים) Mount of Olives.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:4">R. Hash. II, 4</cite>; Tosef. ib. II (I), 2; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 56b">Sabb. 56ᵇ</cite>, quot. fr.
